reviews.text: WOW!!!! Had the absolute BEST experience here tonight. Between the dining and service, it was the ultimate fun and friendly combo. Shoutout Matteo (a stellar server), Aisia, Meklit, Maria, Nicky, Hasmik, Aimee, Annabel, and Mia (for her awesome trivia) as well as Vicco!!! Will definitely be coming back. - also, highly recommend the new menu Korean BBQ Pork Lettuce wraps, a new staple for this group of girls. - Sofie, Jules, Veronika

Our Local spot. The vibe is lively. The food is consistently delicious. Our server, Mia, was outstanding, friendly and a stellar host.

Whether Hubby and I are without kids around or taking the whole family with us, Local will always be our go-to.
